title: Carousel is responsive by orientation
content: The shared Carousel now switches Swiper direction by viewport: horizontal on desktop and vertical on small screens. Books and magazines both use the same coverflow presentation style through the shared Carousel defaults.

title: Newspaper viewer supports two-page spread
content: The newspaper viewer has a 1-page/2-page toggle. In 2-page mode it renders the active issue and the next issue side by side and navigation moves by two entries.

title: Books carousel uses flip mode
